report: The Future of Truth and Misinformation Online
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Information environment improves
entries.quote: In the next 10 years, on balance, the information environment will be IMPROVED by changes that reduce the spread of lies and other misinformation online.
entries.option_b: In the next 10 years, on balance, the information environment will NOT BE improved by changes designed to reduce the spread of lies and other misinformation online.
entries.subject: online misinformation
entries.note: Lead question: will trusted methods emerge to block false narratives, or will the quality and veracity of information online deteriorate?

notes: One question from a canvassing fielded 2017-07-02 to 2017-08-07. The question asks about 'the next 10 years' and names no year; target_year 2027 is read from that horizon. Non-random opt-in canvassing.
